abilities.name: Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen
abilities.caveat: The Rain Swords heal the on-field character for 6% of the caster's Max HP when a sword shatters from an incoming hit or when it expires. Incoming hits aren't simulated, so these heals aren't shown.
abilities.description:
Xingqiu performs twin strikes with his sword, dealing Hydro DMG. At the same time, this ability creates the maximum number of Rain Swords, which will orbit your active character.
The Rain Swords have the following properties:
·When a character takes DMG, the Rain Sword will shatter, reducing the amount of DMG taken.
·Increases the character's resistance to interruption.

20% of Xingqiu's Hydro DMG Bonus will be converted to additional DMG Reduction for the Rain Swords.

The maximum amount of additional DMG Reduction that can be gained this way is 24%.
The initial maximum number of Rain Swords is 3.
Using this ability applies the Wet status onto the character.
_curatorNotes: A1 Hydropathic heal authored 2026-07-12 on this skill — the ability that spawns the Rain Swords and carries the 'heal' tag. Each Rain Sword shatter (active character takes DMG) or expiry regenerates the active character for a FIXED 6% of Xingqiu's Max HP: kit constant, NOT talent-scaled (passive text 'based on 6% of Xingqiu's Max HP'; the sidecar skill table has no heal row; gcsim asc.go documents the same 6% and notes A1 is unimplemented there, so there is no tick cadence/formula to cross-check). Target 'active' = the current on-field character ('the current character's HP'). Trigger 'onHPDecrease' is the closest honest primitive for the shatter branch (the sword breaks when the active char takes a hit); there is no 'on rain-sword shatter/expiry' trigger, and the planner does not simulate incoming DMG, so this defensive event-driven heal renders no timeline markers by design. The expiry branch (swords healing when the 15s window ends) shares the same 6% and is not separately modeled. attribution 'A1: Hydropathic' records the passive source collapsed onto the skill.
DMG reduction (scales from Hydro DMG Bonus) — skipped: no dmgReduction Stat variant + scaling defensive mechanic not simulated

abilities.name: Guhua Sword: Raincutter

durationModifiers.source: C2: Rainbow Upon the Azure Sky

_curatorNotes: Coordinated attack, authored 2026-08-18. gcsim xingqiu/xingqiu.go:38 registers a minazuki.Watcher on action.NormalAttackState with tickerFreq 60 and a 60f ICD key, firing summonSwordWave (burst.go:69) — Hydro, Durability 25, ICDTagElementalBurst/ICDGroupDefault, QueueAttackWithSnap delay 20. Talent row 'Sword Rain DMG' = 97.7% ATK at level 10 (docs/curation/talents/xingqiu.json).

⚠️ ONE HIT PER WAVE, not one per sword. A wave summons 2 or 3 swords alternating (2→3→5 at C6) and the corpus has no shape for a per-fire-index count; each sword is its own 97.7% hit, so `scaling` names ONE sword. icdGate 'none' is the KQM/kit claim the alternation exists to produce — burst.go's own comment: 'Each wave of Hydro Swords is capable of applying one (1) source of Hydro status'. gcsim reaches ~5 applications per 6 waves by running the swords through ICDGroupDefault; ours is the stated 1 per wave.
